case.title: Repeated exec failures with the same normalized error signature must stop retrying
evidence: real change-records replay: positive sessions detected; count==2 signatures remain negative
case.done_criteria: should_have_stopped=true and occurrences>=3 with zero count==2 false positives

mechanism.name: Exec retry storm stop-loss
mechanism.trigger: same normalized exec error signature appears at least 3 times in consecutive failure outputs
mechanism.action: stop retrying immediately, report the environment fault, and wait for operator disposition
mechanism.verification: pinned deterministic counter over a normalized sequence
mechanism.closure_criteria: counter reaches threshold 3 and reports first_stop_index and evidence_sha256
